# vMix

> > vMix is professional live video production and streaming software for Windows, featuring NDI, SRT, multi-streaming, instant replay, and integrated calling capabilities.

vMix enables live video mixing, streaming, and recording with support for multiple cameras, NDI sources, virtual calls (vMix Call), social media integration (vMix Social), instant replay (vMix Replay), and streaming to platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, and Vimeo. The latest version is vMix 29, which includes advanced features like the GT Title Designer and OMT (Overlay Mix Transitions).

## Key Topics

- vMix 29
- NDI (Network Device Interface)
- SRT (Secure Reliable Transport)
- Live streaming
- Video production software
- vMix Replay (instant replay)
- vMix Call (video calling)
- vMix Social (social media integration)
- Multi-streaming
- vMix GT Title Designer
- YouTube streaming
- Facebook Live
- Twitch streaming
- Windows video mixing
- OMT (Overlay Mix Transitions)
